cohort: Neonates >=34 weeks gestation with clinically suspected early-onset infection were recruited from a neonatal intensive care unit and postnatal ward at a tertiary hospital between January 2016 and March 2017.
finding: PCR/ESI-MS detected bacterial DNA of organisms considered pathogenic in four times more blood samples than culture alone, and its detection was significantly associated with higher CRP values.
followup_time: Within 72 hours of suspected infection (for CRP measurements)
gest_age: >=34 weeks gestation, with a median (IQR) of 39.7 (37.5-41.0) weeks
